# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary analysis documents generated alongside the core AppCAT assessment report. Each document explores a specific aspect of the PhotoAlbum application to support cloud migration planning.

## Supplementary Documents

| Document | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) | Application architecture layers and component relationships, with Mermaid flowchart diagrams showing the technology stack, data storage, and component interactions |
| [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) | Visual map of all external NuGet dependencies grouped by functional category, including version compatibility risks and test dependency inventory |
| [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) | API endpoint inventory, service catalog, communication patterns, DTOs, and a sequence diagram of the primary request flows |
| [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) | Database configuration, entity model ER diagram, EF Core data access patterns, and data classification/sensitivity analysis |
| [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) | Comprehensive inventory of all configuration sources, runtime profiles, properties, secrets workflow, and framework/runtime versions |
| [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) | Core business workflows (upload, browse, view, delete), business rules, validation logic, and a sequence diagram of the primary upload workflow |
